turns.assessment: The only positive optical symptom is a pre-FEC BER increase at the S10 receiver of och127, while received power, estimated OSNR, DGD, SOP rate, and the far-end interface metrics remained unchanged. That isolates the problem to a channel-specific quality penalty, principally either degradation of trx.och127.z itself or an upstream WSS filter shift. The evidence cannot distinguish those causes to the 80% threshold; additionally, the no-change list inconsistently includes the same pre-FEC BER counter reported by O1.

proposals.rationale: Receiver-local degradation directly explains increased pre-FEC BER at this receiver with normal power, estimated OSNR, DGD, SOP rate, and unaffected traffic on other optical channels.

A shifted or narrowed WSS passband on och127 could degrade BER while leaving channel power normal and avoiding the all-channel effects expected from span or amplifier faults. Available monitoring does not identify which upstream ROADM, if any, is responsible.
Margin erosion can be reported as worsening BER at the receiver, but the observed discrete level change is less consistent with the documented slow decline.
